description: scores/saves/<slot_id>.json (gitignored runtime save-slot body; no data/ content file pairs with this schema - validate_data skips data/schemas/). Written ONLY by game/core/savegame.py through engine.data_io.write_validated. 'run_state' (RunState.to_dict, SG-2) and 'session' (SG-2) are now tight; 'tile_map' and 'buildings' remain intentionally loose placeholders as of SG-2 - SG-3/SG-4 each tighten their own node in place as they land, per SaveGamePLAN's phased build order.

buildings.description: One entry per live building at save time (registry.py::save_building output, SG-3) - includes buildings currently mid-move (their tile holds no occupant; they are reachable only via tile_map.moving_orders).

building_type.description: LEAF_CLASSES key - selects the leaf class on restore.

gameobject.description: GameObject.to_dict() output (engine/core, E-15) - id/name/tags/transform/components, generic for every building type.

fields.description: Component.to_dict()'s field map - shape varies per component type, never validated further here (D-2's fail-loud belongs to restore_building's own component-match check, not the schema).

type.description: Component class name (e.g. TierState, Health, BoostReceiver).

id.description: GameObject.id uuid - the stable identity wall-owner/moving-order references and mortar_slow_snapshot_ids (SG-2) resolve against.

rank.description: Omitted at its default (0) - the manifest row_start/slice optional-by-omission convention.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this slot was created (the autosave that wrote it).

map_id.description: The active map this run was played on.

pinned.description: True if this slot is exempt from FIFO eviction.

round_num.description: The round this save was taken at - always a multiple of 5 in practice (the autosave cadence). Duplicated from run_state.round_num so the index can show it without loading the full body.

run_state.description: RunState.to_dict() output (SG-2) - the DURABLE fields only. Every other RunState field is a transient/drained-by-UI ledger that resets to its dataclass default on load (D8) and is never written here.

boss_lives_snapshot.description: Base lives snapshotted at the last boss round's End Turn, for the win/loss compare.

boss_love_snapshot.description: Love snapshotted at the last boss round's End Turn.

boss_upgrade_choices.description: Per-run history of (boss_num, upgrade_id, outcome) triples the base-info popup reads.

boss_upgrade_stacks.description: upgrade_id -> pick_count, the whole implementation of every persistent boss-upgrade passive.

buildings_placed.description: Buildings placed over the whole run (a run stat).

enemies_killed.description: Enemies killed over the whole run (a run stat).

first_end_turn_cutscene_requested.description: One-shot latch: whether the run's first End Turn already requested the first_end_turn cutscene.

levelup_pending.description: Whether an XP level-up is queued to open at the next ROUND_END (XP leveling mode only).

lightning_level.description: 0 = lightning locked; >0 = unlocked, a pure UI/gating signal (each firing building reads its own tier for damage/radius/cooldown).

love_spent_on_tiles.description: Running total of love spent unlocking tiles this run (the tile_refund boss upgrade's payback source).

mortar_slow_snapshot_ids.description: GameObject.id uuids of every mortar alive when the mortar_slow boss upgrade was picked - id(building) memory addresses translated to stable uuids for this save (D5), translated back to id() on load.

phase.description: Always BUILDING - RunState.to_dict() only ever saves at a round boundary (D1).

player_xp.description: Current XP toward the next village level.

round_num.description: The round this run is on.

season.description: 0-based ground-art season index, derived from round_num.

state.description: Always GAMEPLAY - RunState.to_dict() only ever saves a live, non-game-over run.

tutorial_intros_shown.description: Whether this run's tutorial-round enemy-intro entries have already been shown (suppresses their authored-round repeat).

unlocked_buildings.description: building_type -> whether that type is unlocked.

used_painter_tiles.description: [col, row] of every tile that hosted a completed Painter payout - permanently barred from hosting another.

xp_threshold.description: XP required to reach the next village level.

xp_threshold_inc.description: How much xp_threshold grows per level.

session.description: Session-level save fields (SG-2). Everything else on Session is a balance reference re-attached at load time from the currently-loaded balancing files, never serialized.

combat_speed_idx.description: Index into Session.COMBAT_SPEEDS (1x/1.5x/2x/pause) - persists across rounds within a run.

slot_id.description: Unique id; also the stem of this file's own path, scores/saves/<slot_id>.json.

tile_map.description: TileMap.save_state() output (SG-4) - runtime deltas from the deterministic legend baseline only (state/condition/spawn-deco per tile, the stage-system counters, in-transit moving orders). No wall edges - see save_state()'s own docstring for why the caller re-derives those via rebuild_walls() instead.

cols.description: Map column count (duplicated here for make_summary's minimap sizing, so the index need not load tile_map to size the grid).

moving_orders.description: Buildings currently in transit between two tiles (Building Movement) - despawned, held alive only by this list.

building_id.description: GameObject.id uuid of the moving building - resolved against the buildings list.

retire_cursor.description: How many spawn-reserve batches have been retired past the scripted max.

stage.description: The run's designer-driven stage counter (TileMap._stage) - never decreases.

tile_deltas.description: One entry per tile whose runtime state differs from the map's legend-derived baseline: an unlock/recede zone-state change, a rolled (not painted) condition, or a rolled spawn-deco tree.

condition.description: Present only when this tile's condition was RANDOMLY rolled (Tile.condition_rolled) - the TileCondition enum name.

condition_variant_idx.description: Present alongside condition - the stable art-variant index rolled for it.

spawn_deco_roll.description: Present only when a spawn-band tree was rolled for this tile (!= -1, the packed variant_idx*2+flip_bit encoding).

state.description: The TileState enum name this tile is actually at.

unlock_purchases.description: Raw tally of successful 2x2 unlock purchases this run (gates nothing; kept as a useful readout).

unlocked_tiles.description: Every unlocked (BUILDABLE or BUILT) tile's [col, row] at save time - the minimap source (D4: no image bytes stored). Duplicated from tile_map for the same reason as round_num.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write - equals created_at, since a slot is never overwritten by a later autosave (D3: every autosave creates a new slot).

version.description: Document format version. Only 1 exists; a future bump is a schema change.

title: savegame
